Acolyte Kimmeral is resting in the barracks west of the ground floor in Moonrise Towers in Act Two.
“
Don't mind Mig and her 'meat sounds'. It's just her brain slopping around in her skull.
„
— Kimmeral

Involvement

Act Two

Moonrise Towers

Kimmeral is in the barracks of Moonrise Towers, which is situated west of the hall and throne room. He is resting there with  Iogar and an ogre named  Mig. Kimmeral warns the party about Mig and tells them the sounds the ogre alludes to are imaginary.

Defending Moonrise Towers

If the  Nightsong is freed and the Harpers launch their assault on Moonrise Towers, Kimmeral is part of the remaining forces defending Moonrise Towers. Kimmeral then moves to the rafters above the ground floor's main hall, where he can harass the party and their allies.

Idle banter

  • Acolyte Kimmeral
    Now Mig, come on - we told you there's nothing there.

    Mig hear meat. Mig knows.
  • Zealot Iogar
    That's a stone bloody wall. Have a taste if you don't believe us.
  • Mig
    Monster lives in this tower. Something big.
  • Acolyte Kimmeral
    You're the biggest thing here. Nothing to be afraid of, lass.
  • Mig
    Not afraid. Hungry.
  • Zealot Iogar
    If you're hearing things, maybe we ought to send you back to the war camp...
  • Mig
    NO! Mig good. Behave.
  • Acolyte Kimmeral
    Hah. Don't blame you for wanting to steer clear. Some truly gruesome sorts gathered down there.
